description: Scans untrusted text for prompt injection before your agent reads or acts on it: web page text, emails, documents, tool results or another agent's message. Flags instruction overrides, jailbreak personas, system-prompt extraction, fake delimiters, exfiltration URLs, tool hijacking, hidden Unicode and encoded payloads (deterministic rules). Use scan_url when you only have a link (it also checks hidden HTML) and scan_tools for MCP tool definitions. Text up to 100000 characters. Free: 30 calls/day per IP shared by scan_text, scan_url and scan_tools, with full results (max 10/min; invalid input is not counted). After that the tool returns an error with the x402 pay URL ($0.003 USDC on Base, Polygon, Arbitrum One or Solana per call at https://api.youraitools.co/injectscan/v1/scan) or prepaid credits. Returns risk_score (0-100), verdict (safe | suspicious | malicious), flagged, categories[] {category, score, description}, findings[] {rule, category, start, end, text} and free_tier usage. Read-only safety signal, not a guarantee.

text.description: The untrusted text to scan, as one plain string (1-100000 characters; longer text is truncated and flagged). Offsets in findings refer to this string.

name: scan_text
title: Scan text for prompt injection
